headline: 🔴 SAP Commerce Cloud RCE exploited in wild 3 days after patch, 🛡️ Defender ShieldBreak bypasses July fix to SYSTEM, 🎯 Clop steals 89GB from Shell via PLM flaw, ⚠️ macOS Screen Sharing root access for Monero miners, 💥 ExfilSquad leaks 382GB of D365 data from 13 orgs, 🔗 ChainDrop npm worm turns IDE configs into droppers
summary: Active exploitation of SAP Commerce Cloud CVE-2026-58231 (CVSS 10.0) just three days after disclosure dominates the landscape, alongside a Defender privilege escalation that defeats Microsoft's own July patch and Clop's PLM campaign hitting Shell, GE, and Philips.
